name: CKEditor InfoCard
description: Adds an InfoCard span button to CKEditor 5.
project_description:
An InfoCard is an in-line version of an accordion. It makes use of span and has default styling. It is created for CKEditor 5. The module is a fork of CKEditor Abbreviation.

 Features 
 See the images to get an impression of how the module works.

 

 

 

 Post-Installation 
 Don't forget to enable in texteditor settings.
